description: Authentic NASA POWER snapshots, bundled for offline use. SI-assisted code added provenance only; NASA values were not SI-generated.

snapshots.spatialResolution: 0.5 degree latitude by 0.625 degree longitude source MERRA-2 grid; this point represents a grid cell, not a local weather station
snapshots.dataType: Reanalysis: assimilated observations and model estimates
snapshots.license: NASA POWER open data; attribution requested
snapshots.processing: Raw NASA API values preserved. Keys YYYY01 through YYYY12 are monthly values; YYYY13 is API annual value. Fill value is -999. Annual analyses should only include complete valid years. Use day-weighted means for T2M/RH2M; sum precipitation monthly mean mm/day times month day counts for annual mm.
